suspects.title: SQL injection vulnerability via cancel reason
suspects.problem: The cancel reason is interpolated directly into the SQL string via an f-string without parameterization, allowing SQL injection if a user supplies malicious input in the reason field.
suspects.how_to_check: Check how `db.execute` is implemented across the repository to see if it supports parameterized queries or if string formatting should be avoided in favor of tuples.

suspects.title: Missing ownership check on order cancellation
suspects.problem: The query selects only id and status from the orders table and does not verify whether the order belongs to the currently logged-in user, allowing any authenticated user to cancel any other user's order.
suspects.how_to_check: Check the schema of the `orders` table and other route handlers in `app/routes/` to see how user ID ownership is typically verified for order access.
